title: Remove redundant test snapshot filters
body:
Inherited `RUST_LOG` changes the output of commands launched by `TestContext`, so local runs can grow snapshot filters for extra tracing output.

Remove `RUST_LOG` from the environment passthrough and delete the resulting warning filters and redundant per-command environment removals. Also remove obsolete link-mode, interpreter, download, cache-count, and Pyodide filters. The existing snapshots stay unchanged.

## Test plan (on top of CI)

123 focused integration tests passed with `RUST_LOG` and `UV_LINK_MODE` unset. The six tests covering the per-command logging cleanup also passed with `RUST_LOG=warn UV_LINK_MODE=copy`.
